title: ceropegia keithii subsp. carnosa
intro: Ceropegia keithii subsp. carnosa, commonly known as the "String of Hearts" or "Carnosa String of Hearts", is a flowering succulent plant native to South Africa. This plant is known for its heart-shaped leaves and stems, which are adorned with small, delicate flowers. The health benefits of Ceropegia keithii subsp. carnosa include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, while its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
